description: Sequential synthetic Sprint identifier. Each Sprint contains 100 test-case observations.
derivation: Repeated integers from 1 to 50; each Sprint_ID is repeated for 100 test cases.

description: Synthetic identifier of a test case. Test IDs 1 through 100 are repeated in each Sprint.
derivation: Tiled integer sequence 1 through 100 across 50 Sprints.

description: Synthetic source-code churn intended to represent the number of source-code lines added, modified, or deleted for a test/Sprint observation.
derivation: Random draw from Poisson(lambda=45); not extracted from an actual source-code repository.

description: Synthetic cyclomatic-complexity value intended to represent source-code control-flow complexity associated with a test/Sprint observation.
derivation: Random draw from Poisson(lambda=8); not computed from actual source code.

description: Synthetic count of linked or dependent software modules associated with a test/Sprint observation.
derivation: Random draw from Poisson(lambda=3); not computed from an actual dependency graph.

description: Synthetic failure-history count intended to represent how frequently a test case failed in previous execution cycles.
derivation: A 20% high-risk-cluster flag is sampled with Binomial(p=0.2); values are then drawn from Poisson(lambda=6) for high-risk observations and Poisson(lambda=0.5) otherwise. The value is not recursively computed from previous Sprint outcomes of the same test case.

description: Synthetic test execution duration in milliseconds. It is used as an input feature by the legacy model and conceptually represents test-execution cost.
derivation: Random draw from Normal(mean=1500, std=350), cast to integer and clipped to a minimum of 100 ms. This field is not used in the synthetic label-generation risk formula.

description: Synthetic test-age/recency value intended to represent the number of Sprint cycles since a test case was last changed or recently relevant.
derivation: Random integer sampled uniformly from 1 through 12 for each observation; not derived from the actual longitudinal history of the same test case.

description: Binary synthetic target indicating whether the observation is classified as failure/risk-positive in the legacy dataset: 1 for positive/failure and 0 for negative/pass.
derivation: Computed from a sigmoid risk score using Code_Churn, Cyclomatic_Complexity, Dependencies, Failure_History, and Test_Age; thresholded at the global 90th percentile of generated probabilities, followed by random flipping of 3% of labels.

description: Identifier of the open-source project or repository from which the TCP-CI observation originates.
derivation: Derived from the TCP-CI project directory or repository slug.

description: Identifier of the Travis CI build associated with the test execution.
derivation: Taken from `exe.csv:build` and cross-referenced with `builds.csv:id` within the same project.

description: Identifier of the Travis CI job in which the test execution occurred.
derivation: Taken directly from `exe.csv:job`.

description: Timestamp indicating when the CI build started.
derivation: Taken from `builds.csv:started_at` and parsed as an absolute UTC timestamp.

description: Chronological index of a build within a project.
derivation: Assigned after sorting builds within each project by build_started_at with build_id used as a deterministic tie breaker.
history_scope: build metadata through b; no current outcome

description: Fully qualified test-class identifier associated with a TCP-CI execution record.
derivation: Taken from `exe.csv:test`. The downloaded artifact uses an encoded test-entity identifier; its semantic mapping to source entities remains subject to separate inventory verification.

description: Execution duration of the test converted to milliseconds for use as the canonical execution-cost measure.
derivation: Taken from `exe.csv:duration`. The field is complete in the downloaded v3 artifact, but its published-artifact unit has not yet been frozen. No unit conversion is applied at this stage.

description: Binary target indicating whether the test execution failed.
derivation: Downloaded TCP-CI v3 uses `exe.csv:verdict`. Observed mapping: verdict=0 -> failed=0; verdict in {1,2} -> failed=1. Result code 3 is documented by TCP-CI as an unknown failure but was not observed in the local v3 artifact; if encountered, it is mapped to failed=1.

description: Git commit hashes included in the CI build.
derivation: Taken from `builds.csv:commits`.

description: Number of test methods executed in the test class.
derivation: Directly obtained from the TCP-CI execution record.

description: Number of assertion-style failures recorded for the current test execution.
derivation: Directly obtained from the TCP-CI execution record.

description: Number of execution errors recorded for the current test execution.
derivation: Directly obtained from the TCP-CI execution record.

description: Number of skipped test methods in the current test execution.
derivation: Directly obtained from the TCP-CI execution record.

description: Historical failure rate of the same test computed strictly from executions before the target build.
derivation: Number of failed prior executions divided by the number of observed prior executions for the same test.

description: Indicator of whether the most recent observed execution of the same test failed.
derivation: Outcome of the most recent execution of the same test strictly before build b.
history_scope: most recent execution of the same test before b

description: Number of consecutive failed executions of the same test immediately preceding the target build.
derivation: Length of the failure streak ending at the most recent execution before build b.

description: Number of consecutive passed executions of the same test immediately preceding the target build.
derivation: Length of the pass streak ending at the most recent execution before build b.

description: Build-based age or recency measure for the test before the target build.
derivation: Derived from the test history before build b; exact age definition is frozen in Protocol v1.

description: Number of builds elapsed since the same test most recently failed.
derivation: Difference between the target build index and the build index of the most recent failure strictly before b.
history_scope: last failure of the same test before b

description: Historical estimate of test execution cost derived from execution durations available before the target build.
derivation: Mean execution duration of previous executions of the same test. Window definition is frozen in Protocol v1.
history_scope: same test, execution durations from builds < b

description: Number of source-code lines changed in the current build change set.
derivation: TBD_PILOT

description: Number of source files changed in the current build change set.
derivation: TBD_PILOT

description: Source-code churn associated with the current build or test-relevant change set.
derivation: TBD_PILOT

description: Source-code complexity measure associated with code relevant to the test/build.
derivation: TBD_PILOT

description: Dependency-based measure linking the test or test-relevant code to changed code.
derivation: TBD_PILOT

description: Measure of how historical or otherwise pre-existing test coverage relates to the current build change set.
derivation: TBD_PILOT
history_scope: historical/pre-existing coverage plus current build change context

description: Failure density measured over a recent historical build window.
derivation: TBD_PROTOCOL_V1

description: Temporal trend in execution duration estimated from historical executions.
derivation: TBD_PROTOCOL_V1
history_scope: historical execution durations from builds < b
